name: 85143 · San Tan Vly, AZ
findings: ZIP 85143 (San Tan Vly) has 37 nonprofit organizations. 18 of them (49%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 17 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 85143 (San Tan Vly) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 85143 (San Tan Vly) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 39% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 15 organizations here; 35% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?
